content:
Overview

Montpellier is a city in Occitanie with a population of 285,000. A vibrant Mediterranean city with one of Europe’s oldest medical schools, lively student culture, and sunny climate. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
